mood: quiet darker late-afternoon cafe with directional window sun, a broad partial room shadow crossing the product, long attached shadows and off-frame presence

key_light.source: one upper-left window-sun source softened only slightly by glazing and room distance
key_light.relative_size: small-to-medium natural window sun; defined shadows with restrained soft penumbra

ambient_fill: low warm-neutral room bounce and pale floor return retain readable wood pores, cane openings, beverage color and dense contacts without flattening the directional sun

screen_light_map.falloff: restrained sun fields cross chair and pale floor while a broad low-density room-shadow field crosses the primary beverage and surrounding table without crushing wood or beverage color
screen_light_map.off_frame_evidence: one coherent partial window-frame or furniture shadow continues across the product, table and beyond the canvas without revealing its source

shadow_contract.edge: defined directional cast shadows with restrained natural penumbra, plus one broad low-density environmental field crossing the table and product
shadow_contract.vector: lower-right and consistent for beverage, brownie plate, teaspoon, table and chair
shadow_contract.attachment: dense compact occlusion at every support contact; no gap or floating edge

wood_bounce_contract.opaque_container: subtle warm-brown reflected fill only on lower shadow-facing rim and underside; no wood pattern or stain transfer
wood_bounce_contract.transparent_container: physically local refraction of wood grain through clear lower sidewalls; transmitted lift is restricted to the key-side rim, ice edges and a small lower-glass accent while the broad partial environmental shadow remains visible through the container
wood_bounce_contract.edge_integration: match local scene contrast, finite acuity and grain; prohibit bright matte halos and oversharpened masks

capture_contract.white_balance: 3800-4450K subdued warm-neutral window-sun with neutral brown shadow detail and no orange wash
capture_contract.texture: finite phone-camera acuity, real dark wood pores, irregular cane depth, soft paper fibers and restrained sensor grain; never uniformly crisp
capture_contract.hdr: restrained single-exposure social photo; no tone-mapped halo
capture_contract.highlight_protection: milk, foam, ice, plate and pale floor retain texture; no glowing white beverage body
capture_contract.black_detail: wood pores and cane openings remain readable in shadow

forbidden: milk or fruit bleached by transmitted light
